description: Build a canonical payment request (payee, chain, token, amount, memo, expiry) and return the digest for THE PAYEE to sign with their own wallet. Robyn does not sign these and holds no payee keys — a request signed by Robyn would prove nothing about the payee. Use this when an agent needs to ASK another agent for money in a way the payer can actually check.
name: robyn_payment_request_prepare
title: Prepare a payment request for the payee to sign
